result.title: A poem about applied rationality by ChatGPT

contents.markdown:
In a world of chaos and confusion,  
Where emotions often rule the day,  
It can be hard to see the truth,  
And make decisions in a clear and wise way.

But there is a path to clarity,  
A way to think that's reasoned and refined,  
It's called applied rationality,  
And it can help us make choices that are kind.

With this tool, we can weigh the facts,  
And consider all the options that we face,  
We can think logically and objectively,  
And make choices with a clear and level headspace.

So let us embrace applied rationality,  
And let it guide our thoughts and actions too,  
For when we think clearly and objectively,  
We can make choices that are good for me and you.

With applied rationality by our side,  
We can tackle any challenge that we face,  
We can solve complex problems with ease,  
And make decisions with grace and poise.

It can help us in our personal lives,  
As well as in our work and careers,  
It can improve our relationships,  
And help us overcome our deepest fears.

So let us never lose sight of this,  
The power of applied rationality,  
For when we think clearly and objectively,  
We can make the world a better place for you and me.

Applied rationality is a beacon of light,  
In a world that can be dark and cold,  
It helps us to see what's real and true,  
And make choices that are wise and bold.

It can give us confidence and clarity,  
And help us to overcome our doubts,  
It can guide us on the path to success,  
And help us to achieve our goals and aspirations.

So let us embrace applied rationality,  
And let it be our guiding star,  
For when we think clearly and objectively,  
We can achieve greatness, near and far.
